subject: app-rdef
title: APP.RDEF. -----STF. ------SOC.RT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 250 (CMOA(II)-8). APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; STF (source transfer) and SOC-RT (social reality) are the partners in the title. LANG-DY (language dynamics) is on a dotted line from the subject. From STF: SOC-RT. From SOC-RT: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From LANG-DY: POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ALT-F: AFTF (affinity transfer) and CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). From AFTF: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). From CRTF-D: PR-TRS.
